attacks.title: Night of 6–7 October
attacks.summary: A ballistic missile attack hit non-residential areas in Obolonskyi, Shevchenkivskyi and Podilskyi districts, started a fatal fire at a garage cooperative in Darnytskyi district, and damaged the Dovzhenko Film Studio.

audit_examples.explanation: Site 6 (c26, c29, c35: 'За іншою адресою ... падіння уламків на відкритій території') is open-ground debris, the same kind of event as Site 4 (c6, c8, c10, c12: Darnytskyi 'уламки впали на відкритій території'). Same place type, same weapon, same night, and no source gives a different district. These likely describe one debris site in Darnytskyi and are double-counted.
audit_examples.public_note: May be the same open-ground debris fall as the record in Darnytskyi district.

audit_examples.explanation: c26, c29 and c35 say 'За іншою адресою ... падіння уламків на відкритій території' and have district null. They only say a different address, not Darnytskyi. The site summary admits no district is given and merges them by assumption into the Darnytskyi debris site (c6, c8, c10, c12). They should be a separate site or left unplaced. The summary also says 'Missile debris', but the Darnytskyi claims say only 'уламки' with weapon unknown.
audit_examples.public_note: Debris on open ground reported at an unnamed address; district unconfirmed, may not be Darnytskyi.

attacks.title: Night of 7–8 October
attacks.summary: Russian drones attacked Kyiv in the evening, causing fires and damage in the Solomianskyi, Desnianskyi, Obolonskyi, Sviatoshynskyi and Dniprovskyi districts, with injuries in Solomianskyi and two deaths in a Desnianskyi apartment block.

audit_examples.explanation: Site 5 (c65, c66: "падіння БпЛА в 4-поверхову нежитлову будівлю", Солом'янський) and Site 8 (c17, c31, c62: 4-storey administrative/non-residential building hit by a drone, Святошинський) describe the same kind of object: a 4-storey non-residential building struck by a drone. Only the district differs, and c65/c66 are later repeats from the same source (KMVA) that issued c62. This may be one strike with a district discrepancy, so it risks double-counting. Merge them or justify keeping them separate.
audit_examples.public_note: May be the same 4-storey non-residential building strike as the Sviatoshynskyi district record.

audit_examples.explanation: Site 7 is the Sviatoshynskyi administrative building. Its claims describe roof debris and partial roof destruction, without fire. c65 and c66 say "В Соломʼянському районі падіння БпЛА в 4-поверхову нежитлову будівлю", a direct hit in Solomianskyi district. The summary admits the district conflict and merges them anyway, only because both are 4-storey. That is a guess. Make c65 and c66 a separate Solomianskyi site. They are repeats of each other. The summary should also drop the speculation about Solomianskyi.
audit_examples.public_note: A drone hit a 4-storey non-residential building in Solomianskyi district; this may be a separate strike.

audit_examples.explanation: Site 11 (c58, 'БпЛА влучив у двір між житловими будинками', Оболонський) is very likely the same strike as the burning car in a residential courtyard in Site 10 (c63, c37 'палає авто в дворі житлового будинку', drone debris). The morning summaries (c60-c64) list one drone incident per district, and nothing else in Оболонський is a courtyard hit. Counting it separately double-counts the Obolon strike.
audit_examples.public_note: May be the same courtyard car fire in Obolonskyi district.

audit_examples.explanation: Site 14 (c59, 'Ще один російський дрон поцілив у житловий будинок у Деснянському районі') is probably the 12-storey residential building hit by a drone in Site 13 (c52, c57, c64). It is a vague description from the same morning Suspilne Kyiv roundup, and the KMVA 08:30 summary names only one Деснянський building. 'Ще один' means another drone after the Obolon one, not a second house in Desnianskyi. Treating it as separate double-counts.
audit_examples.public_note: May be the same drone hit on the 12-storey residential building in Desnianskyi.

attacks.title: Night of 13–14 October
attacks.summary: Russian ballistic missiles and drones struck Kyiv overnight and into the morning, hitting a nine-storey block in Desnianskyi district, TPP-4 and other energy facilities, a non-residential building in Holosiivskyi and several smaller sites, with at least five people killed in total.

audit_examples.explanation: Site 3 (c9, c11, c13, c17) says "Також пошкоджений житловий будинок, зараз рятувальники гасять пожежу". It is a damaged residential house with a fire, reported in the same wave as the TPP-4 hit. Site 1 is the only other residential strike with a fire in this attack, and the 9-storey block was burning at the same time (c4 at 22:57, c18 at 23:52). c78/c79 (BBC) also pair TPP-4 with a single high-rise: "влучили по ТЕЦ-4 і висотці". No source describes a second residential fire, so site 3 is probably the Desnianskyi 9-storey building and the strike is double-counted.
audit_examples.public_note: May be the same residential fire as the 9-storey building record in Desnianskyi district.

audit_examples.explanation: Site 1 pulls in four claims (SES, KMVA, Ukrainska Pravda, Suspilne) that say "Також пошкоджений житловий будинок, зараз рятувальники гасять пожежу". They come right after the TPP-4 hit. They name no district, no storey count and no casualties, and they say blast_damage, not a direct hit. Nothing links them to the Desnianskyi 9-storey block. The site summary itself admits the link is an assumption ("is treated as the same building"). These claims should be a separate residential-building site, or kept apart until a source ties them to the Desnianskyi building.
audit_examples.public_note: A damaged residential building with a fire was reported near the TPP-4 strike; its exact location is unclear.

dropped.title: Drone crash on highway
dropped.why: c43 says a drone crashed 'on a highway near Kyiv'. No place in Kyiv city is given, and the summary itself says it may be outside city limits. It should be excluded from the city record.

audit_examples.explanation: c43 (Kyiv Post) says the drone crashed 'on a highway near Kyiv'. It gives no district or address inside the city, so it can't be placed in Kyiv city. It reads as an incident outside the city limits.
audit_examples.public_note: This drone crash on a highway is described only as 'near Kyiv' and may be outside the city.

audit_examples.explanation: Site 1 joins the debris hits and ground-floor facade damage on 5-storey buildings (c2, c4, c6, c12) with c42, a missile that 'вдарила посеред житлового сектору' and left a 'величезна вирва' in Vidradnyi. A direct missile crater and a debris hit are different incidents. The weapon on the site is set to ballistic and the target to highrise only because of c42, c38 and c44. The summary mixes 'debris' and 'missile crater' as one event.
audit_examples.public_note: Reports of debris on a five-storey block and of a missile crater in Vidradnyi may describe different places.

audit_examples.explanation: c43 says the drone crashed 'on a highway near Kyiv'. It gives no place inside the city. The site itself admits it may be outside city limits. It should not be published as a Kyiv city impact site.
audit_examples.public_note: Location is a highway near Kyiv and may be outside the city limits.

audit_examples.explanation: c24 says a drone fall caused a fire 'на території нежитлового сеетору' in Sviatoshynskyi. c40, in the same district, says SES put out a rubbish fire 'на території покинутої промзони'. These are probably the same non-residential or industrial territory. Site 8 instead puts c24 with c41, a roof fire in a two-storey building, and nothing ties c24 to that building. The Sviatoshynskyi fires may be double-counted, or c24 may be attached to the wrong one.
audit_examples.public_note: This may be the same strike as another record from this attack.

audit_examples.explanation: Site 1 joins the Solomianskyi 5-storey building hit by debris (c1, c2, c4, c6, c12: 'влучання уламків', facade damage) with c42, a missile that 'вдарила посеред житлового сектору' in Vidradnyi with 'величезна вирва'. It also joins c38 (Kyiv Post 'residential blocks') and c44 (hromadske 'житлові будинки'), which name no address. The summary admits they 'may describe other buildings'. The address 'мікрорайон Відрадний' and the weapon 'ballistic' come only from c42 and the unlocated generic claims, not from the debris reports (weapon unknown). Split c42 into its own crater site. Put c38 and c44 in a separate generic residential site or leave them out.
audit_examples.public_note: A missile crater in the Vidradnyi area may be a different strike from the debris hit on a 5-storey block.

audit_examples.explanation: c43 says a drone crashed 'on a highway near Kyiv'. No place in Kyiv city is given, and the summary itself says it may be outside city limits. It should be excluded from the city record.
audit_examples.public_note: A drone crash on a highway near Kyiv; the location may be outside the city limits.

audit_examples.explanation: c24 is a fire on a 'нежитлового сектору' site after a drone fell (07:56). c40 is a different report: 'загоряння сміття на території покинутої промзони', with no drone named. The summary only guesses 'probably the same place', and the drone weapon and 'industrial' target are carried over from one claim to the other. Site 9 (c41, a roof fire on a non-residential building) may also overlap c24. Nothing confirms any of these locations match, so keep them apart or confirm the match.
audit_examples.public_note: Reports of fires in Sviatoshynskyi district may describe one place or several; sources do not confirm.

attacks.title: Night of 16–17 November
attacks.summary: Russia struck Kyiv overnight, mainly hitting the Northern and Southern bridges with ballistic missiles. Debris also caused fires in several districts, metro surface infrastructure was damaged, and two people were killed in Obolonskyi district.

audit_examples.explanation: c44-c47 are one Ukrainska Pravda sentence: "пошкодження інфраструктури та пожежі в Голосіївському, Деснянському, Дніпровському та Оболонському районах". The place is "unspecified infrastructure (district-level report)". The matcher put each one into a specific site: c44 in the Southern Bridge site, c45 in the Northern Bridge site, c46 in the Dniprovskyi warehouse site, c47 in the Obolonskyi warehouse site. The sentence names no bridge and no warehouse. The claims should be removed from these sites and either dropped or kept as a separate generic district-level record.
audit_examples.public_note: A general report of damage and fires across four districts is not tied to a specific site.

audit_examples.explanation: Site 8 is titled 'Building', but c31/c37/c43 only say 'В Оболонському районі зафіксовано дві пожежі' and the place is 'unspecified location (second fire)'. No claim mentions a building. The summary says 'One was at warehouses', which restates the warehouse fire already in Site 7 (c30/c36/c42). The site should be the unspecified second fire only, with a neutral title.
audit_examples.public_note: Part of the description may not be backed by the sources.

attacks.title: Night of 19–20 November
attacks.summary: A combined drone and ballistic missile attack on Kyiv damaged three Dnipro bridges, a water utility facility, infrastructure sites, non-residential buildings, St. Volodymyr's Cathedral and two embassies, and killed at least six people.

audit_examples.explanation: Site 11 (c43, c45, c50) is a summary of the same three bridges that sites 8, 9 and 10 already cover. c45 and c50 name Podilsko-Voskresensky, Darnytskyi and Southern, and c43 says 'three bridges'. As a separate site it double-counts them as a fourth strike. These claims belong under the three bridge sites, or should be dropped.
audit_examples.public_note: This may be the same strike as another record from this attack.

audit_examples.explanation: Site 11 has district Darnytskyi, but none of c43, c45 or c50 gives a district. They describe bridges across the whole Dnipro.
audit_examples.public_note: District for the combined bridge report is not confirmed by sources.

audit_examples.explanation: c41 and c42 are one generic Military Administration sentence: 'В Подільському та Дарницькому районах ... постраждала транспортно-логістична інфраструктура'. It names no bridge. Site 8 got the Podilskyi half and site 9 the Darnytskyi half, but nothing ties them to those specific bridges. The summaries and districts rest on this guess.
audit_examples.public_note: Generic transport-damage reports for Podilskyi and Darnytskyi districts may not refer to these bridges.

audit_examples.explanation: Site 10 (Southern Bridge) has district Darnytskyi, but none of its claims gives a district. They only say 'Південний міст'. The district is invented.
audit_examples.public_note: District for the Southern Bridge is not stated by sources.

audit_examples.explanation: Site 8 has district 'Дарницький' for the Podilsko-Voskresensky bridge crossing. No claim about this crossing gives a district (all are null). c68 calls it the 'Подільський мостовий перехід', and Darnytskyi is the name of a different bridge. The district should be null or unspecified.
audit_examples.public_note: District for the Podilsko-Voskresensky bridge crossing is not confirmed by sources.
